details: is a software company that specializes in developing natural-sounding speech synthesis software using deep learning. It was founded in 2022 by Polish entrepreneurs Piotr Dąbkowski and Mateusz Staniszewski. ElevenLabs is legally incorporated in the US. It is based in London and also has offices in New York City, Warsaw and San Francisco.

explainer.lead: ElevenLabs is a software company focused on using deep learning to make synthesized speech sound natural. Founded in 2022, it is based in London and also has offices in New York City, Warsaw, and San Francisco.

tiers.eli5: ElevenLabs builds computer voices designed to sound natural, a bit like a skilled narrator reading aloud instead of a robot reciting words. It was started in 2022 by Polish entrepreneurs Piotr Dąbkowski and Mateusz Staniszewski.
tiers.practitioner: An engineer would consider ElevenLabs when an application needs natural-sounding speech synthesis rather than recorded speech. Its stated technical foundation is deep learning; output quality, latency, and licensing still need to be checked for the intended application.
tiers.paperLevel: ElevenLabs Inc. is a US-incorporated software company, founded in 2022 by Piotr Dąbkowski and Mateusz Staniszewski, specializing in natural-sounding speech synthesis using deep learning. It is based in London, with additional offices in New York City, Warsaw, and San Francisco.

explainer.example: A developer uses ElevenLabs' speech-synthesis software to turn the sentence “Your train leaves at 9:15” into natural-sounding spoken audio for an application.
